rule: Only main may supply current operational truth, active block, current next action, canonical Hub identity, or production readiness. Non-main branches are historical/proposal/experiment scope unless explicitly promoted by a main-branch control-plane record.

classes.DEFERRED: non-main branch with an explicit future-boundary record
classes.HISTORICAL: merged/non-current branch or recorded prior execution source
classes.REJECTED: branch explicitly rejected by a main-branch record
classes.ABANDONED: branch explicitly abandoned by a main-branch record

proof_rule: A proof sourced from a non-main branch is never current proof unless its claim scope explicitly names the branch and the main control plane records the promotion/acceptance.
cold_naya_rule: A cold Naya must not inspect non-main branches to determine current truth; it reads main control-plane sources first.
